hint_ladder: Correct or sharpen what was just said instead of agreeing with it flatly.
Use if anything with a comma before the corrected version.
Start with the words: The weather didn't improve; if ___, it got worse.
teaching_content.reveal_form: The weather didn't improve; if anything, it got worse.
canonical_forms: The weather didn't improve; if anything, it got worse.
alternative_realizations: He isn't lazy — if anything, he works too hard.
